_doc: A2.9/A2.9a: diario de Dex, capítulo 4. A3.6: reescrito con el capítulo de la biblia (admisión de Nurse Gwei, condición de Satoshi, piscina, réplicas, MemeLAB, duelo de FUD y autorización). p4_records y p4_mountain se quedan (el listado del CRT y la subida se pueden hacer tarde). Ver qa/README.md § Diario.

goals.text: Get admitted to the clinic. As a patient.
Learn to fight Chad: three sources of comebacks and one thing he can't argue with.
Get the doctor to open the treatment room.

notes.text: Badge available — connect a wallet to keep it (optional).
The Ledger opened Adrian's vault on the CRT. There's a map to something called 'Patient Zero Clinic'.
Patient roster: 'PATIENT ZERO — STATUS: ESCAPED'. Escaped through what? The printer gave me a map.
Nurse Gwei only lets in patients. Proof of symptoms: insomnia, loss. Denial she tests herself.
Insomnia and loss on file. Now I have to pass a denial test. I've been training my whole life.
Admitted. Diagnosis: textbook. I have a wristband. Mum would be so proud.
Satoshi only opens the treatment room to group therapy graduates. Chad runs the group. Downstairs, behind the patient records.
The pool apes accepted me. Gerald approves. I've been ignored by better people, but never by wetter ones.
'The Art of the Rug', chapter 3: comebacks are learned at the shallow end, the deep end, and the bar.
Comebacks (shallow end): 'At least mine float. Yours sank in a kiddie pool.' / 'A broken clock is right twice a day. You're on a streak of zero.'
Comebacks (deep end): 'And you sold the bottom so often, they gave you a loyalty card.' / 'Then today they'll hear you lose.'
Comebacks (the bar): 'Still more detail than your exit plan.' / 'I can tell. They left the receipts floating in the pool.' B.O.T. says Chad has never made anything.
A rare Pepe from the MemeLAB. 'SPECIMEN #001 — by P.Z.' P.Z. Patient Zero made something people still want.
Beat Chad. With a frog. He gave me his sobriety token. Worth nothing. That's the point.
Satoshi read Adrian's envelope: the original referral. The patient's name is under a coffee stain.
Satoshi authorized the treatment room. The door also has a physical keyhole. Dual lock.

hints: The basement computer has more to say. Feed it.
The chip from the dead rack. Adrian's Ledger. The floppy. In that order.
Use the burned chip, then the Ledger, then the floppy disk on the basement computer.
The printout is a map. Maps are for walking.
Out the front door. The far left of the yard.
Leave the house by the path on the far left.
Clinics want proof. You have symptoms. Find them in a form a slot can scan.
Insomnia comes in cans. Loss comes in crumpled notes. The clinic bin has both.
Pick up the note from the clinic trash can, then use a can and the note on the visitor box.
She's testing denial. So don't be honest. Be in denial.
Honest fails. Lying fails. Believe your own nonsense.
Buzz the intercom and say you can stop whenever you want. You just don't want to.
You want the treatment room. Ask the man who owns the door.
Satoshi. Ask him straight about the treatment room.
Talk to Dr. Satoshi and ask to see the treatment room.
Group meets downstairs. Downstairs is behind something heavy.
Push the filing cabinet. Then the apes need a reason to respect you. Fur, or a duck.
Wear the ape costume, or pick a rubber duck from the junk pile and use Gerald, the giant duck.
You don't beat a roaster without a script. Steal one.
The book by the pool says where: shallow end, deep end, the bar.
Talk to the apes on the left, the apes on the right, and order a drink from B.O.T.
Chad's weakness: he never made anything. Find something somebody made.
Behind the DEEP LIQUIDITY door. Your eyes will need help in there.
Use your 3D glasses in the MemeLAB, then pick up the rare Pepe.
Every FUD has exactly one comeback that answers it.
Tops, bags, roadmaps. Then the big one: what did you build?
Loyalty card, kiddie pool, exit plan. Then show him the Pepe.
Chad said the Doc collects those.
Satoshi. The token. Upstairs.
Talk to Dr. Satoshi and tell him you beat Chad.

anonIdle: Fresh air. Use it. Don't use me.
